items.title: 67559_Art Hodes oral history interview
items.q: I call Wild Bill, he wants $275. I says to Brunis, in our meeting with the band, let's give it to him... When we hit the road and start making money, he still gets $275 and we get more

ctx.x: Sidney deParis, something like -- yeah, it might have been Sidney deParis. It was a driving band. That was the first date, I think. But then they started coming. They became very popular, in a very short time. And those records became popular. When they made the one with Wild Bill and Sidney Bechet, everybody thought, man, this is the greatest. This is what hot is, a hot band. And we were very --
Had that band ever worked together?
